Welcome to Space Treck!

  Your goal is to navigate the stars and planets in your rocket ship and make discoveries at each stop.
  As you begin Space Trek, you will see a map of the stars and planets surrounding you as well as your ship, marked by ">=>" 
  Use the Arrow keys to move through space and to new planets
  At each stop, you will receive instructions on which planet to travel to next, as well as information about your current location.

  Reach all the planets and read the files for each in order to finish Space Treck!
